If that holds, the leverage is in the unglamorous part of the loop. Devin can take a service with thin coverage, write the missing tests in its own environment, and open a PR your reviewers judge like any other. Litera reports 93% faster regression cycles.

Worth a short call to pick one service and see what comes back?

Best,

I'd value 20 minutes on where you think delegated agents break down in a large codebase, and I can share what we've learned from test-generation work in return.
